title: Step 2 - NLP Data Preprocessing in R: Importing TSV Files for Sentiment Analysis

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So in the previous tutorial, we imported the data set which contains 1000 reviews of a restaurant.
cues.zh: 上一堂匯入包含一千則餐廳評論的資料集。

cues.en: And for each of the review, we have the information whether the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 每則都有正面、負面資訊。

cues.en: So one, when the review is positive and zero when the review is negative.
cues.zh: 正面 1，負面 0。

cues.en: And we are trying to build a machine learning model that will be able to classify each new review and tell if this new review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 想建立能分類新評論、判斷正負的機器學習模型。

cues.en: So basically what we are led to do is something we already did that is classification in part three.
cues.zh: 基本上就是第三部分做過的分類。

cues.en: But this time we are working on texts and therefore we need to figure out a way to create a model where we can have some independent variables to train a machine learning classification model
cues.zh: 但這次是文字，必須想辦法建立一些自變數，訓練分類模型，

cues.en: to learn some correlations between the independent variables and the dependent variable, which is of course, the liked column.
cues.zh: 學習自變數與應變數 Liked 欄之間的相關性。

cues.en: So, now the goal is simply to create some independent variables.
cues.zh: 所以目標是建立自變數。

cues.en: And what could be those independent variables?
cues.zh: 可以是什麼？

cues.en: Well, the idea in natural language processing and that's the bag of words model, is to create a model which will basically be a huge table;
cues.zh: NLP 的詞袋想法，是建立一個大表格模型。

cues.en: A table where the rows are nothing else than the reviews.
cues.zh: 各列就是評論。

cues.en: So this table will have 1000 rows because we have 1000 reviews, one row for each review.
cues.zh: 一千則，所以一千列，每則一列。

cues.en: And the columns will simply be all the words that we can find in the reviews.
cues.zh: 各欄是評論裡所有詞。

cues.en: You know, we take the 1000 reviews, we look at all the words in those 1000 reviews and we are gonna create one column for each word.
cues.zh: 取一千則，看所有詞，每個詞一欄。

cues.en: And then, each cell in the table will correspond to one road that is one review and one column that is one word in all these words, in these 1000 reviews.
cues.zh: 每格對應一列、一則評論，以及一欄、一個詞。

cues.en: And then this cell, there is going to be the number of times the word appears in the review.
cues.zh: 儲存這個詞在這則出現幾次。

cues.en: So for example, here is the first word, Wow.
cues.zh: 例如第一詞 Wow。

cues.en: Well, there is gonna be a column for this Wow word here.
cues.zh: 有一個 Wow 欄。

cues.en: And so for the first line that corresponds to the first review, well this Wow column will get a one because the word Wow appears once in the first review.
cues.zh: 第一列對應第一評論，Wow 欄是 1，因為出現一次。

cues.en: But then for all the other reviews that is all the other rows, we don't see any Wow here, so all the cells in this first column for the other rows will get a zero.
cues.zh: 其他評論、其他列沒有 Wow，所以這第一欄其他格是 0。

cues.en: And that's what will be our model in the end.
cues.zh: 最後模型如此。

cues.en: It's gonna be this huge table with 1000 rows that are gonna be the reviews and a lot of columns that are gonna be all the words that we can find in this 1000 reviews here.
cues.zh: 大表格，一千評論列，加上所有評論詞的很多欄。

cues.en: So now, you might start to figure out why we would need to clean the reviews.
cues.zh: 現在應該開始了解為何要清理。

cues.en: It's because, since we're gonna take all the words in these reviews here, well, we are gonna get a lot of columns because we create one column for each word.
cues.zh: 因為每詞一欄，全部保留會很多欄。

cues.en: But we don't want to get too many columns because the more we get some columns and the harder it will be for our machine learning model to run properly, to execute efficiently.
cues.zh: 不想太多，越多模型越難正常、高效率執行。

cues.en: Not only our machine learning model will have more trouble to execute properly, but also it will have more trouble understanding the correlations between the presence of the words and the reviews
cues.zh: 不只執行更困難，也更難理解詞的存在

cues.en: and the information whether the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 與評論正負資訊間的相關性。

cues.en: Because of course, if we keep all the words in these reviews, well, we will get some irrelevant words; Some words that will not help the machine learning algorithm
cues.zh: 全部保留會有無關詞，無法幫演算法

cues.en: to predict if a review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 預測正負。

cues.en: Because, in all the words that we can find in the reviews here, well, some words give a much better hint in telling if the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 某些詞，比其他詞更能提示正面或負面。

cues.en: Let me give you a simple example.
cues.zh: 簡單例子。

cues.en: We have this Loved word here.
cues.zh: 這裡 Loved。

cues.en: In this review, this is the word that basically tells us that the review is positive because there is this Loved word.
cues.zh: 基本上告訴我們正評，因為有 Loved。

cues.en: But then if we look at this, This word or even Place, well, these two words don't give the machine learning algorithm a hint whether the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 但 This，甚至 Place，兩者不提供正負線索。

cues.en: It's of course this word, Loved, by which the machine learning algorithm will understand some correlations between this Loved word and the fact that the review is positive.
cues.zh: 當然是 Loved，讓演算法理解此詞與正評的關聯。

cues.en: So, that's the whole reason why, right now, we are going to clean the text.
cues.zh: 這就是現在清文字的原因。

cues.en: It's not only to reduce the big table we're gonna get to the end because we want our algorithm to run properly and not be saturated.
cues.zh: 不只縮小最後大表格，讓演算法正常執行、不飽和。

cues.en: And the other reason is that we want to get the most relevant words to find the best correlations between the presence of the words and the outcome whether the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 也想取最相關詞，找到詞出現與正負結果間最好的相關性。

cues.en: All right, so now we get the point.
cues.zh: 懂了。

cues.en: So let's start cleaning the reviews.
cues.zh: 開始清理。

cues.en: And an important thing to understand is that what we'll do here to clean the reviews, well, it's the same technique to clean any other kind of texts.
cues.zh: 要了解，這些清理評論的方法，也適用其他文字。

cues.en: Well, I will give you the main tools.
cues.zh: 會提供主要工具。

cues.en: You will be able to use these tools to clean any text you're working with.
cues.zh: 可以用來清理任何文字。

cues.en: And of course, if your text is a little more complicated, like for example, an HTML pages that contains HTML tags, well, you would need to add a little more tools
cues.zh: 若更複雜，例如 HTML 頁有標籤，要加一些工具，

cues.en: but you would still use the tools that we are about to use.
cues.zh: 但仍用即將介紹的工具。

cues.en: And the good news is that if you want to use more tools to clean more sophisticated texts, well, you just need to ask me some questions in a QnA and I'll help you add these tools to your problem
cues.zh: 好消息是，若要用更多工具清理複雜文字，只要問答區問，我會幫你加到問題

cues.en: and your text.
cues.zh: 與文字中。

cues.en: But, what we'll do here, you will definitely do it to perform natural language processing on your text files for your problems.
cues.zh: 不過這裡的做法，你對自己文字檔做 NLP 一定會用。

cues.en: All right, so let's do it.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's clean the text.
cues.zh: 清文字。

cues.en: So that's the next step in natural language processing.
cues.zh: NLP 下一步。

cues.en: We will clean all the text and then we will create our bag of words model, which is this huge table which is actually called a Sparse Matrix because we'll get a lot of zeros in the sparse matrix.
cues.zh: 清所有文字，再建立詞袋，也就是大表格，實際叫稀疏矩陣，因為有很多 0。

cues.en: And then that means that we'll get a model where we have some independent variables and one dependent variable and that's when we'll be able to use our machine learning classification models
cues.zh: 就有包含自變數與一個應變數的模型，能使用第三部分

cues.en: that we built in part three to predict the class of a new review that the model will not have seen yet.
cues.zh: 分類模型，預測沒見過新評論的類別。

cues.en: So, let's do it.
cues.zh: 來吧。

cues.en: Let's start with the first step of cleaning the text.
cues.zh: 先第一個清理步驟。

cues.en: And this first step is going to be about initializing a corpus.
cues.zh: 初始化語料庫。

cues.en: Because, you know, we will not clean the reviews directly in the data set.
cues.zh: 因為不直接在資料集清評論。

cues.en: We will instead create a corpus which will contain all the reviews and that will be in this corpus that we will clean all the reviews.
cues.zh: 改建 corpus，包含所有評論，在裡面清理。

cues.en: So, let's start by creating this corpus.
cues.zh: 先建立。

cues.en: And, in order to create this corpus, we need to import a package.
cues.zh: 需要匯入套件。

cues.en: And you might need to install it if it's the first time you're doing natural language processing.
cues.zh: 第一次做 NLP 可能要安裝。

cues.en: So I'm going to type here the command to install this package.
cues.zh: 輸入安裝命令。

cues.en: This package is called the tm package; It's a very famous package in R for natural language processing.
cues.zh: 叫 tm，是 R 中非常有名的 NLP 套件。

cues.en: So, let's install this package by typing install.packages.
cues.zh: install.packages。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 來了。

cues.en: And so the name of the package has to be input in quotes which is the tm package.
cues.zh: 引號內填套件名稱 tm。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So, if I go to my packages, I will find the tm package.
cues.zh: 到 Packages，找到 tm。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 這裡。

cues.en: So I already have it installed so I don't need to install it again.
cues.zh: 已安裝，不必重裝。

cues.en: So I will put that in comment.
cues.zh: 改註解。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And, of course, if you don't have the tm package here, you will need to install it by executing this line and everything will run properly.
cues.zh: 若沒有 tm，執行這行安裝，就會正常。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So of course, after we install the package, we need to import the package where mine is already imported but we need to automate all this, so, as usual, we are gonna take the library command,
cues.zh: 安裝後要匯入，我的已匯入，但要自動化，所以照慣例 library，

cues.en: and in parenthesis, we input the name of the package.
cues.zh: 括號套件名。

cues.en: So tm again, not in quotes.
cues.zh: tm，不加引號。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now we are ready to build the corpus.
cues.zh: 準備建 corpus。

cues.en: And so how are we gonna call our corpus?
cues.zh: 要叫什麼？

cues.en: We're gonna call it corpus.
cues.zh: corpus。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: corpus equals and now we're gonna use the V Corpus function, spelled this way, V Corpus with capital V and capital C.
cues.zh: corpus 等於，使用 VCorpus，大寫 V、C。

cues.en: And then in parenthesis, we need to input vector source, this way.
cues.zh: 括號裡 VectorSource，這樣。

cues.en: And again, new parenthesis.
cues.zh: 再括號。

cues.en: And it's in these parenthesis that we input the column that contains the text that we want to clean in this corpus.
cues.zh: 這裡輸入包含要在語料庫清理之文字的欄。

cues.en: So this column is of course, the review column of our data set.
cues.zh: 當然是資料集 Review。

cues.en: So here we will input this column which can be taken the following way by typing data set, dollar sign, and then, as you can see, we have, the two variables here that we can pick.
cues.zh: 輸入 dataset，再 $，看到可選的兩個變數。

cues.en: And the one we want to pick is review.
cues.zh: 選 Review。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And that takes all the review column of our data set.
cues.zh: 取得整個 Review 欄。

cues.en: And that's exactly what we want because this column contains the text and we want to clean the text in the corpus.
cues.zh: 正是要的，包含文字，要在語料庫清理。

cues.en: All right, so, that's the first step of cleaning the text.
cues.zh: 這是文字清理第一步。

cues.en: So let's select this and press command or control plus enter to execute and create the corpus.
cues.zh: 選取，按 Command 或 Ctrl 加 Enter，建立 corpus。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: As you can see, it already says that it's a large corpus and we can even see here that our corpus takes 3.7 megabytes of space.
cues.zh: 已顯示大型語料庫，甚至看見佔 3.7 MB。

cues.en: We will simplify this corpus by cleaning step by step all the reviews and that's what we'll do in the next tutorials.
cues.zh: 接下來逐步清每則、簡化語料庫，之後幾堂做。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning!
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
